# Network allow-list (read by .github/scripts/check-network.mjs; CONTRACT §7 item 12).
#
# Nexum makes exactly one kind of network request: the update check, and the update
# download after the user clicks Install (CONTRACT §2.15). All of that code lives in one
# file. CI fails on any network-client API in src-tauri/src/**, nexum-agent/**/*.cs and
# src-frontend/** (reqwest, ureq, hyper, HttpClient, WebClient, HttpWebRequest, TcpClient,
# TcpListener, TcpStream, UdpClient, UdpSocket, HttpListener, WebSocket, XMLHttpRequest,
# EventSource(, sendBeacon, fetch(, axios, tauri_plugin_updater, updater_builder) outside
# the entries below.
#
# This list can hold exactly two entries, and the script rejects anything else:
#
#   src-tauri/src/updater.rs            the updater module, as a whole file
#   src-tauri/src/lib.rs:<line>         the ONE line that registers the updater plugin
#                                       (.plugin(tauri_plugin_updater::Builder::new().build()))
#
# The frontend and the sidecar cannot be allow-listed. When the registration line moves,
# the check fails and prints the new line number to write here.

src-tauri/src/updater.rs
src-tauri/src/lib.rs:236              # .plugin(tauri_plugin_updater::Builder::new().build())
